```cpp
const Profile::MESG* Profile::GetMesg(const FIT_UINT16 num)
{
    const Profile::MESG* const table = mesgs;
    int low = 0;
    int high = static_cast<int>(MESGS) - 1;

        if (midNum == num)
            return &table[mid];
        if (midNum < num)
            low = mid + 1;
        else
            high = mid - 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}
```
